items.markdown:
![Best Bangkok Riverside Hotels on the Chao Phraya River](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07281357-1672-0139-0000-96287dc07e2e:4)
The best riverside hotels in Bangkok include [Capella Bangkok](https://www.capellahotels.com/en/capella-bangkok), [Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok](https://www.mandarinoriental.com/en/bangkok/chao-phraya-river) , and [Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort](https://www.anantara.com/en/riverside-bangkok) . These properties offer direct river views, boat access, and top-tier amenities along the Chao Phraya River.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/HotelsList-Bangkok-Hotels-On-The-River-zfp552073.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/HotelsList-Bangkok-Hotels-On-The-River-zfp552073.html)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/O5S6XU8YEsc)[[3]](https://www.anantara.com/en/riverside-bangkok)[[4]](https://northabroad.com/where-to-stay-bangkok/)[[5]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/HotelsList-Bangkok-Hotels-On-The-River-zfp552073.html)

Ultra-Luxury Stays

- **Capella Bangkok** : An ultra-exclusive modern retreat where every room faces the river, featuring private balconies or verandas and fine dining by Mauro Colagreco.[](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/O5S6XU8YEsc) 
- **Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok** : A historic, legendary five-star hotel known for timeless elegance, exceptional service, and prime positioning right on the water.[[1]](https://en.itravelblog.net/best-stay-in-riverside-bangkok/)[[2]](https://www.travelup.com/en-gb/blog/best-hotels-in-bangkok)[[3]](https://voyeglobal.com/hotels-to-stay-in-bangkok/)[[4]](https://www.agoda.com/travel-guides/thailand/bangkok/luxurious-oasis-in-the-heart-of-bangkok-a-complete-guide-to-mandarin-oriental-hotel-bangkok/)
- **Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok at Chao Phraya River** : A stylish, contemporary sprawling luxury property with open courtyards and vibrant art-focused design.[[1]](https://www.thehotelguru.com/best-hotels-in/bangkok/riverside)[[2]](https://destinasian.com/update/bangkok-has-the-best-city-hotel-in-thailand-according-to-destinasian-readers)[[3]](https://www.fourseasons.com/bangkok/accommodations/specialty-rooms/four-seasons-river-view-room/)

Resort and Modern Styles

- **Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort** : A low-rise tropical resort set amidst lush gardens, offering a relaxed pool scene and cultural boat trips.[](https://www.anantara.com/en/riverside-bangkok) [[1]](https://www.booking.com/district/th/bangkok/riverside.en-gb.html)[[2]](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/travel/destinations/asia/thailand/bangkok/hotels/anantara-riverside-hotel/)[[3]](https://www.enchantingtravels.com/hotels/bangkok/anantara-bangkok-riverside-resort-spa/)[[4]](https://www.luxewellnessclub.com/en/anantara-riverside-bangkok-escape-on-the-banks-of-the-chao-phraya/)
- **Avani+ Riverside Bangkok Hotel** : A chic, high-rise option featuring a stunning rooftop infinity pool and panoramic views of the city skyline and river.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gAMuo5Behig&t=54) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gAMuo5Behig&t=54)
- **Chatrium Hotel Riverside Bangkok** : A popular choice offering spacious suites with private balconies and a large river-facing infinity pool.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2J2sLmcwovI&t=15) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2J2sLmcwovI&t=15)

- Your **budget range** per night
- Whether you prefer a **historic style** or a **modern high-rise** 

I can narrow down the exact recommendation for your trip.
